sar_reference.narrative: On or about 2016-12-28, financial institution investigation identified unauthorized transactional activity impacting customer C08299 on payment card C08299-K1. Flagged transaction 3581141 totaling $30.02 was executed under patterns characteristic of PatternEnum.CARD_NOT_PRESENT_FRAUD. Graph traversal analysis identified connections across account profiles and device entities (DEV_2edf2958166561c5), involving an aggregate suspicious exposure of $30.02. Cardholder inquiry verified the activity was unauthorized. The institution has blocked card C08299-K1, placed linked cards under protective monitoring, and submitted this Suspicious Activity Report pursuant to FinCEN guidelines and Bank Fraud Policy R2/R6.
